title: Essential: Angular velocity
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly calculate and state the angular velocity at which the block slides off, ω = 2 rad/s.

title: Essential: Horizontal range
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly calculate and state the final horizontal range, s = 0.4 m.

title: Important: Centripetal force condition
description: Important Criteria: The student must apply Newton's second law for circular motion, equating the centripetal force to the kinetic friction force.

title: Important: Projectile time of flight
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly calculate the time of flight using the vertical free-fall equation from height H.

title: Important: Horizontal projectile motion
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly relate the horizontal range to the tangential speed at slip (v = ωR) and the time of flight.

title: Optional: Unit consistency check
description: Optional Criteria: The student demonstrates unit analysis for angular velocity (rad/s) and range (m), confirming dimensional consistency.

title: Pitfall: Wrong friction force
description: Pitfall Criteria: Using static friction coefficient incorrectly or misapplying the friction direction (e.g., using μN for static max without the slip condition).

title: Pitfall: Sign or unit error
description: Pitfall Criteria: Making arithmetic errors in the calculation of ω or s, or omitting units in the final answer.
